name: Rahul Varma
player_statement:
A complete player, Rahul Varma has made a big mark in cricket. With 27 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 33*, with an average of 16.44 and a quick strike rate of 149.43. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 30 sixes and 9 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 23.0 overs, taking 14 wickets at an economy rate of 15.00. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
